app.title: From a routine stroke scan to its network-level consequences
app.subtitle: Upload a lesion and run reproducible, versioned analysis pipelines on it. Every result carries the exact tools, parameters and reference data that produced it.
app.loginPrompt: Sign in with the account provided by the platform administrator.
app.featureLesion: A CT scan with its lesion mask, or a mask already in MNI space, checked and brought to standard space.
app.featureNetwork: Lesion network mapping and tract-wise disconnection against normative connectomes.
app.featureProvenance: Versioned steps, pinned reference data and a full provenance record for every run.
app.researchOnly: Research use only. Not for clinical decisions.

upload.title: Upload study
upload.hintFormat: A T1w anatomical image in .nii.gz format is expected. Enter a BIDS identifier such as sub-O01; if left empty, the system will generate a safe one.
upload.hintDuration: Processing can take between 10 minutes and 1 hour.
upload.invalidSubject: The BIDS identifier must have the format sub-XXXX, for example sub-O01.
